data.body: Close blocker split: completion verification refused a fixed close because the original persistent-/mcp-502 defect can still recur under concurrent gate load (single nginx upstream/no failover plus unbounded or undecided capacity/concurrency prevention). I split that residual prevention work to `trivial-protected-barracuda` (85a5-97ff-4a47-4c77) and linked it as `supersedes` + `discovered_from` this ticket. AC5's measurement campaign is separately split to `inherited-americium-porpoise`. Closing this parent, if possible, should therefore use `--class superseded`, not `fixed`.
